feeds.name: Haryana Roadways (Haryana, statewide)

source.name: Haryana Roadways' depot timetables (hartrans.gov.in) and its live tracking, built into GTFS by reclaim.city
source.detail: Unofficial: Haryana Roadways publishes no GTFS, no stops and no route lines. Routes and stops from the route labels its buses carry on its live tracking (the official Haryana app's backend): each label read into its towns in order, placed by bus-stand aliases and OpenStreetMap place names, joined by OSRM's road (haryana_bus/places.py, network.py). Trips from the 25 official depot timetables (last updated 2 Dec 2024): every departure whose From and To are a route's two ends. Only the departure time is published: later towns are estimated from OSRM's driving time x 1.25 plus 3 min at each town (timepoint=0). Corridors with no timetabled departure, and private (kilometre scheme) and other states' departures with no live Haryana Roadways route, are left out (haryana_bus/gtfs_build.py).

feeds.note: Unofficial: built from Haryana Roadways' depot timetables and live tracking; stops are towns and bus stands, times after the first are estimates (timepoint=0).

feeds.name: Bhilwara (city e-buses, PM e-Bus Sewa)

source.name: Katch city bus tracking (katchapp.in/bus_tracking): the cities' published route maps (KML) and live GPS, built into GTFS by reclaim.city
source.detail: Unofficial: the PM e-Bus Sewa city operators publish no GTFS. Routes, stops in order and route lines from the route maps (KML) each city publishes on Katch's tracking pages (katch_bus/network_eb.py); departures from the buses seen starting each route on the live tracking, later stops timed from the median running times seen (timepoint=0); routes with no departure seen yet are listed without a timetable (katch_bus/gtfs_katch.py).

feeds.note: No timetable: the source holds routes and stops only, so there is no GTFS feed; the routes and their stops are in the CSV.
